_readme: Live sources pulled by `flprops refresh`. Only entries with "enabled": true run.
kind=arcgis: paste a FeatureServer/MapServer *layer* URL (ends in /0, /1 ...). Find them on the
county or city open-data hub (search '<county> open data parcels' or 'code enforcement'),
open the dataset, choose 'View API resources' / 'I want to use this' and copy the layer URL.
kind=socrata: give the domain and the 4x4 dataset id (e.g. data.cityofxyz.gov, abcd-1234).
field_map maps our fields (left) to the source's field names (right). A list joins fields.
target=parcels updates the parcel table; otherwise rows become events of event_type.
Event types: lis_pendens, foreclosure, foreclosure_sale, tax_delinquent, tax_deed, lien,
code_violation, probate, death, bankruptcy, eviction, divorce, utility_shutoff, vacant, other.
county_overrides lets you correct or add portal URLs used in links.
Optional direct API to your skip-trace provider. Copy the endpoint, request body and response
field paths from YOUR provider's API docs. Placeholders: {first_name} {last_name} {address} {city} {state}
The key is read from the environment variable named in api_key_env; never put it in this file.
Without this, use: flprops skiptrace-export -> upload to provider -> flprops skiptrace-import.
skiptrace.name: my-provider

deal_defaults._readme: Override any key from flprops/deals.py DEFAULTS, e.g. assignment_fee, rehab_psf, refi_rate.
